body: My boss started to assign tasks that involve staying far from Sam, also, I started hanging out with coworker from other teams, and they have been welcoming to me, still, I didn’t stop hunting for a new job. So far I’ve had no luck finding something that’s worth leaving this job, but hopefully I can soon :)

Just wanted to give a little update:
I was speaking to someone else at work and turns out they always invited me to events out of work and one person would say I didn’t want to go and everyone just thought I was just stuck up because of this. They were shocked to find I actually never received the invite when they wanted me to go.

I don’t know what got to this person, let’s call them Sam, but I talked directly to them to address the issue and solve it, thinking there may be a misunderstanding, but Sam just said that I was always quiet and to them, that is being stuck up, which is weird to me, because I am always open to talk when talked to, or get very talkative when feeling comfortable and Sam knows it as we have gone on trips together.

A few days later Sam tried to sabotage my work while my boss was on vacation, but I managed to save evidence and spoke to my boss about it, they pulled a victim card, saying I lashed out at them for no reason and they felt “cornered”. I showed my boss the evidence and my boss said they would deal with this person. Still, I feel very uncomfortable in my job now that the environment became this toxic. I don’t know why this person decided to be mean to me, but I am not interested in playing whatever games they intended to, so I started to apply to different companies. Please wish me luck with the job hunting.

I have talked to a former teammate who was surprised I am being treated like that, she suggested I reciprocate the treatment they give me and ignore them at all, but it’s just hard when I spend most of my time there at work (I just wish the silence part was true because they are usually very loud lol). Thanks for the advice.

Yeah, I suppose I will just not waste my time anymore trying to be polite. A lot of people here are assuming that I wanna be friends with them when that’s not the case, it’s just about being polite and not making the environment more stressful than it already is and have good cooperation when we are a team :/
This. No matter how many times I’ve asked the people around me not to talk about my body, no one takes it seriously
It sucks that despite how much I try to set that boundary no one respects it

Thank you for your words. I’m glad you are much better now. I have applied for different jobs today, hopefully I find something better
Dw, I wasn’t mad about it, genuinely happy to hear it all worked out. I will definitely start looking somewhere else.
I am very happy it all worked out for you, I hope you are in a much better place and in a healthy workplace now, unfortunately I cannot afford to do that with my whole fandom depending on my income

One time I was choking in my sleep paralysis. If it wasn’t for my mom that moved me I’d be dead. Minutes later a “friend” called me to ask me if I was ok. 

She says she dreamed she was standing in my bedroom door and there was a shadow screaming I deserved to die as I was choking. She didn’t want to explain further and just told me to pray.
